newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMERCIAL BANK LAUNCHES NEW BRANCHES.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK LAUNCHES NEW BRANCHES.

text.p: Commercial Bank of Greece said it opened three new branches -- two in Athens and one in the island of Patmos in the Dodecanese.
The new branches in Nea Erythrea and Metamorphosi as well as the one in Scala, Patmos offer the full range of banking services, it said.

They include 24-hour telebank access, Hermes mutual funds, Phoenix, Metrolife -Commercial insurance products, mortgages and personal loans and brokerage services via subsidiary Commercial Securities. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
